ae_item_base_info_dto.detail:
Hair Dye Shampoo 5-in-1 for Men can quickly dye both hair and beard,
giving you a fresh look instantly.This set includes shampoo and conditioner
for an all-in-one formula,thoroughly cleansing and enhancing the lustre and
smoothness of hair and beard.Additionally,the specially added ingredients
help fosterhealthy hair and scalp,making it easier to get thicker hair and get
rid of thinning hairproblems.


Use

Step 1Put on the gloves.Press out the ingredients from the bottle,make sure two kinds of ingredients come out together.

Step 2Mix the two ingredients in the palm.

Step 3 Apply the ingredients on white(gray) hair and massage the hair as with normal shampoo.

Step 4 After 15-20 minutes (depending on hairlength),the longeryou wait,the darkerit becomes.Then wash hair with clear water.

Warnning:

Please do a skin allergy test before dyeing your hair. Apply the ointment for a while behind your ears, leave it for 10-20 minutes, wipe it off, and wait for 48 hours for no redness, swelling or allergic reaction before use.


Feature

Quick Dye: Instantly dyes hair and beard for a fresh look.

5-in-1 Formula: Combines shampoo and conditioner for comprehensive care.

Thorough Cleansing: Effectively cleans hair and beard. Enhanced Lustre: Adds shine and smoothness to hair.

Nourishing Ingredients: Supports healthy hair and scalp.

Thicker Hair: Helps address thinning hair problems and promotes thicker growth.d

Gentle on Scalp: Suitable for regular use without irritation.

Easy Application: Simple to use, making grooming quick and convenient.

Long-Lasting Color: Provides enduring results that look natural.

Non-Staining: Formulated to avoid staining skin or clothing.
